picks.title: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar: "Money Cannot Buy A Quiet Mind" | Ep. 440 with Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar Founder of Art of Living Foundation
picks.summary:

picks.title: #1202 - Three Coincidences That Prove God Exists
picks.summary:
In this episode, Trent Horn examines three major coincidences that make atheism increasingly difficult to accept: the fine-tuning of the universe, the strange reality of objective moral facts, and the massive number of miracle claims throughout history. Taken together, these point toward a universe that looks far more like the product of design, purpose, and divine action than random chance.

picks.title: No More Games - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E4
picks.summary:
Following Jesus isn’t a negotiation. We don’t get to set the terms, hold onto certain parts of our lives or simply swap a few habits. Jesus came for our hearts, and His invitation is to surrender everything.
In this message from Matthew 22, we’re reminded that the question isn’t just what we believe about Jesus, but whether He is truly Lord of our lives. When we stop playing games, stop negotiating and give it all back to Him, that’s where true life is found.
